summary: Phase 10 Marketplace Administration tested end-to-end (API + UI). Backend: test_phase10_admin.py 4/4 pass; new tests/test_phase10_t1_extended.py 4/5 pass (MFA gate, /admin/staff 410, no ledger edit, invite create/list/revoke + revoked token 410, refund > threshold -> 202 pending_approval, requester 403 on own approval, support_admin 403, 2nd finance admin approves -> real Stripe refund created, double-decide 404, ticket linked to own order / other customer's order rejected / closed ticket reply 409, banner hide removes from homepage, content_admin 403 on all non-content endpoints & exports). FAIL: banner cta_url accepts protocol-relative '//evil.com' and '/\evil.com' (open redirect). Probes found 4 endpoints returning 500 on malformed ids. UI (1920 + 390): super admin login -> /admin -> /admin/mfa, wrong code rejected, TOTP -> admin-home with all 10 links + 7 exports, tickets CSV downloads; team page invite (link prompt shown since email not sent), revoke invite, self role change blocked with toast; /admin/vendors, /admin/payments, /admin/fulfillment, /admin/tickets, /admin/content render for super admin. Content admin sees only admin-link-content, no exports, no ops/finance/tickets stats; banner add/hide/delete works and shows on homepage; javascript: URL rejected; featured unpublished id rejected. Support admin sees only tickets link + tickets export; filters, status/priority/queue/assign-me, internal note + public reply work; customer sees public reply only, status waiting_for_customer -> open after customer reply; other customer cannot open ticket. Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow on /admin, /admin/tickets, /account/support. One significant frontend bug: after SPA login an admin is NOT redirected to MFA (blank /admin).

minor.issue: cta_url regex ^(|/[^\s]*|https://[^\s]+)$ accepts protocol-relative '//evil.com' and '/\evil.com'. HomepageContent renders these via <Link to> (startsWith('/')) which React Router treats as external -> open redirect / phishing link on homepage. Fix pattern e.g. ^(|/(?![/\\])[^\s]*|https://[^\s]+)$.

If pay.create_refund raises after claim, approval stays in 'processing' forever (no rollback/error state); also threshold is per-request so a finance admin can split a large refund into several sub-threshold refunds to bypass second approval (consider cumulative per vendor order).
422 message surfaces raw pydantic text "String should match pattern '^(|/[^\s]*|https://[^\s]+)$'" to the content admin — use a friendly message.

ui_bugs.issue: After logging in via /login?next=/admin the admin lands on /admin with a BLANK page instead of /admin/mfa. RCA: POST /auth/login returns user without is_admin/mfa_verified (only /auth/me adds them, auth.py:131), so ProtectedRoute's `user.is_admin && !user.mfa_verified` check is false; /admin/overview then 403 mfa_required and AdminHomePage renders null. Works only after a full reload. Fix: in AuthContext.login call fetchMe() after login (or return the same fields from /auth/login). Also plain /login (no next) sends admins to /account, never prompting MFA.
Opening another customer's ticket (API 404) renders an empty area with no 'Ticket not found' message (no .catch on load).

Admin pages are guarded only by 'any admin role'; e.g. content_admin can open /admin/vendors, /admin/tickets, /admin/team directly and sees empty shells (API correctly 403s). Consider permission-based route guard / forbidden message.

issues: Nav link buttons in lg:grid-cols-5 grid overflow: 'Payments, refunds, disputes & payouts' text spills over and overlaps 'Support tickets'; 'Orders, cancellations & returns' overflows its pill. Use fewer columns, allow wrapping (whitespace-normal, h-auto) or shorter labels.

suspend/reactivate/revoke all shown for every admin regardless of status (reactivate shown for active users) and on own row; uses window.prompt for password (no masking) — consider a proper dialog with password input.

action_items: HIGH: AuthContext.login should refetch /auth/me (or /auth/login should include is_admin + mfa_verified) so admins are redirected to /admin/mfa right after SPA login; consider routing admins to /admin/mfa after login when next is absent.
Tighten banner cta_url pattern to reject '//' and '/\' protocol-relative URLs (open redirect).
Validate ObjectIds (return 404/422) in support staff_list assigned_to, revoke_invite, banner_update, banner_delete.
Fix /admin dashboard nav button text overflow at desktop widths.
Friendly validation message for banner URL; 'Ticket not found' state on SupportTicketPage.
Consider: approval stuck in 'processing' on refund failure; cumulative threshold to prevent split-refund bypass; admin MFA session never expires within the 7-day refresh session.
critical_code_review_comments: permissions.py: clean least-privilege mapping; require_perm checks MFA after perm (good). Matches the 5-role spec.

admin_team.py: hashed single-use invites, 72h TTL, last-super-admin guard, no self-change, re-auth and session revocation all verified. invite_link returned in API response when email fails (only to super admin) — acceptable for preview but ensure email works in prod.
mfa.py: replay protection via mfa_last_step, 5-try lockout; GET /auth/mfa exposes permission list (fine).
admin_ops export: CSV values (customer names, ticket subjects) not escaped against spreadsheet formula injection (=, +, -, @ prefixes).

seed_admin gated by ALLOW_ENV_ADMIN_SEED and never alters existing accounts; bootstrap_admin refuses when an active super admin exists. bcrypt $2b$, credentials CORS with explicit origin, httpOnly cookies confirmed.
tests/test_phase10_admin.py teardown deletes content_banners by '^TEST' title regex — should delete by created ids only.

Real super admin and its mfa_secret untouched (only mfa_last_step unset before verifies).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run phase10 tests serially: pytest tests/test_phase10_admin.py tests/test_phase10_t1_extended.py -n 0 (parallel workers race on super admin mfa_last_step). For UI MFA: unset users.mfa_last_step via mongosh, compute TOTP inline (pymongo/pyotp not available in browser tool env) using secret from users.mfa_secret. Login testids: #login-email, #login-password, login-submit-button. After login use page.goto('/admin') (full reload) until the AuthContext bug is fixed. test_05 of t1_extended is expected to fail until banner URL pattern is tightened.
rca of the issue: Admin MFA redirect: LoginPage -> AuthContext.login sets user = /auth/login response.user (user.public() without is_admin/mfa_verified). ProtectedRoute requires user.is_admin to trigger /admin/mfa redirect, so it renders AdminHomePage, whose /admin/overview gets 403 mfa_required -> d stays null -> blank page. Repro: log out, open /login?next=/admin, sign in as any admin. Mitigation: after login call fetchMe()/reload(), or add is_admin & mfa_verified to login response.
